desc:
Start with Rasengan. Train your Chakra, unlock stronger Jutsu, and see if you can become a Jutsu Master!

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Chakra!
✨ Unlock More Jutsu — Discover powerful new abilities and become stronger as you progress!
⚔️ Clear 15 Stages — Defeat enemies and earn Wins to unlock more!
🌀 Build Your Ninja — Collect Auras and roll for Taijutsu styles with unique finishers.
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger!
👹 Battle World Bosses — Take on bosses to earn rare Jutsu and Aura drops.
👥 Join the group for +10% Chakra!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support future updates!
